reviews.title: Perfect WFH monitor.
reviews.comment: This MSI Pro 27” monitor checks all my boxes for my dual monitor work from home setup. I have this monitor as 1 of two monitors on a dual gas spring monitor arm and this monitor is perfect for that setup. To be honest, most people would be happy with one of these monitors. The color is accurate, it is feature rich, and easy to use out of the box.
reviews.author: ibuy2much
